title: Colosseum Psychedelic Vision
description: A surreal painting depicts the Roman Colosseum under a swirling red and purple spiral sky. In the foreground, two stylized female profiles with elaborate teal spiral hair and colorful pins face each other, surrounded by three skeletons, one with bat wings holding a trident, a yellow camera on a plaid cloth, and a pink bowl of fruit with red liquid dripping down a cracked ledge.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting featuring the Roman Colosseum in the background beneath a massive swirling red and purple spiral vortex sky. In the foreground are two stylized female faces in profile with elaborate teal spiral hair adorned with pins and colorful orbs, a trio of skeletons including one with bat wings holding a red trident, a yellow vintage camera resting on a red plaid blanket, and a pink bowl filled with fruit and red dripping liquid over a cracked stone ledge with graffiti text reading Shelter 825, Diagnostics, Nature is the New Colosseum, and Spell Forge.
